story.title: The Safe Distance
story.logline: A man relies on daily voicemails from his future self to avoid disaster, until a panicked warning forces him to choose between safety and actually living.
story.theme: Over-protection and the fear of risk can be more destructive than failure itself.
story.twist: The future self wasn't protecting him from tragedy, but actively sabotaging his chances at happiness to keep him safely isolated.
story.ending: He opens the door to life, forever silencing the terrifying voice of his own cautious future.

scenes.narration: Every midnight, my future self calls my phone. He warns me about tiny mistakes before they ruin my upcoming day.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Leo, a 30-year-old man with dark scruffy hair, wearing a worn dark-blue canvas jacket over a gray t-shirt, staring intently at his glowing smartphone screen inside a dimly lit modern city apartment with dark wooden floors and rain-streaked windows.
scenes.camera: Close-up on face illuminated by phone glow

scenes.narration: He told me to avoid the freeway Tuesday, so I dodged a six-car pileup. He saved my life three times.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Leo, a 30-year-old man with dark scruffy hair, wearing a worn dark-blue canvas jacket over a gray t-shirt, standing on a rainy city overpass watching heavy traffic below under moody streetlights.

scenes.narration: Because of his constant warnings, my life became totally predictable, utterly safe, and completely hollow. I stopped taking any real risks.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Leo, a 30-year-old man with dark scruffy hair, wearing a worn dark-blue canvas jacket over a gray t-shirt, sitting alone at a small wooden dining table in his dimly lit modern city apartment, looking lonely.

scenes.narration: Tonight, my phone rings right on schedule. But when I hit play, his voice isn't calm anymore—he's absolutely terrified.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Leo, a 30-year-old man with dark scruffy hair, wearing a worn dark-blue canvas jacket over a gray t-shirt, holding his glowing smartphone to his ear in his dimly lit modern city apartment with dark wooden floors.

scenes.narration: He whispers, 'Do not answer the knock at your front door tonight. If you open it, everything we built shatters.'
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Leo, a 30-year-old man with dark scruffy hair, wearing a worn dark-blue canvas jacket over a gray t-shirt, turning his head sharply toward his dark apartment front entryway.

scenes.narration: My heart hammers against my ribs. I freeze in the dark hallway as heavy, deliberate footsteps approach outside my apartment door.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Leo, a 30-year-old man with dark scruffy hair, wearing a worn dark-blue canvas jacket over a gray t-shirt, standing frozen in his dark hallway near the heavy wooden apartment entrance door.

scenes.narration: The sharp knock echoes through the silence. I stare at the brass peephole, holding my breath, terrified of what waits outside.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Leo, a 30-year-old man with dark scruffy hair, wearing a worn dark-blue canvas jacket over a gray t-shirt, leaning slowly toward the brass peephole of his apartment door in the dark.

scenes.narration: I break my future self's golden rule and look through the glass. Standing in the dim corridor is a young woman holding flowers.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Distortion effect through a brass door peephole showing a bright, friendly woman holding a bouquet of yellow sunflowers in the hallway outside Leo's modern apartment.

scenes.narration: I realize the truth: my future self wasn't protecting my life. He was a lonely old man protecting his own cowardice from love.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Leo, a 30-year-old man with dark scruffy hair, wearing a worn dark-blue canvas jacket over a gray t-shirt, realizing the emotional shock as he steps back from the door in his apartment.

scenes.narration: I pull the door wide open and smile. Tonight, I finally stop listening to the voice on my phone.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Leo, a 30-year-old man with dark scruffy hair, wearing a worn dark-blue canvas jacket over a gray t-shirt, pulling his apartment door wide open into warm hallway light, smiling genuinely.

caption.hook: His future self was lying all along.
caption.title: The Safe Distance
caption.caption: For years, daily voicemails saved him from heartbreak, failure, and risk. But when the latest message warns him to run, he finally realizes that safety was just a cage built to keep him entirely alone. Is a life without any risk even worth living?
